dishes.name: Canelé
dishes.desc: Small fluted cake with a dark caramelised crust and a soft custard centre scented with vanilla and rum. Born in Bordeaux and sold in bakeries across the city.

dishes.name: Entrecôte bordelaise
dishes.desc: Rib steak grilled over vine cuttings and served with a red wine and shallot sauce, sometimes with bone marrow. The classic Bordeaux brasserie plate.

dishes.name: Lamproie à la bordelaise
dishes.desc: Lamprey from the Gironde estuary stewed in red wine with leeks. An old, strong-flavoured dish, found in season in traditional Bordeaux restaurants.

dishes.name: Arcachon oysters
dishes.desc: Oysters from the Arcachon basin, often eaten with grilled crépinettes sausages and a glass of white wine. The Gironde's best-known seafood.

dishes.name: Pauillac lamb
dishes.desc: Milk-fed lamb raised in the Médoc around Pauillac, roasted pink with herbs. A regional meat with its own label, served in Bordeaux restaurants.
